Maya S.: Heads-up — freeze window starts in ~6h. I'd like to land PR <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/2891|#2891> but mac CI is slow/flaky. Can we coord timing?
Jon Q.: What's failing? I can rerun the job.
CI Bot: CI failure on mac/matrix — test failing: integration/kv_cache_test (flaky on gpu-ci). Suggest: /ci rerun.
Li W.: Left a few tiny comments; needs one more approval from infra. @Prashant R. can you take a quick look? Should be a small tweak.
Prashant R.: On it. If mac keeps flaking we could land behind a staggered-canary rollout, but with the freeze we can't flip new flags.
Release Manager: Reminder — freeze blocks merges after the window starts. If you can get green within ~2h we can still include it in the midnight UTC roll. Otherwise it'll wait for next window.
Maya S.: OK I'll try a rebase to pick up the KV-cache fix and rerun CI. Ping me when review is done.
Jon Q.: If you need help rebasing, call me. I'll watch the CI queue.
Prashant R.: Reviewed and approved. :thumbsup: waiting on CI to pass.
CI Bot: Rerun initiated by Jon Q. — build #4587 queued.
Jon Q.: mac jobs are still backlogged. Suggest rebase onto main@abc123 (that had the cache tweak). Maya — can you rebase + force-push?
Maya S.: Done — rebased onto main@abc123 and force-pushed. Rerun?
CI Bot: Build #4588 started — running mac/matrix.
Jon Q.: If this fails again, we should hold and plan for the next window. Tagging @Release Manager for fallback plan.
Release Manager: Thanks — noted. If build is green within 90m we'll include it; otherwise defer to the next deploy. Keep this thread updated with status and ETA.
Maya S.: Will do. Posting updates here as soon as CI finishes.
